title: Manitoba Museum
geometryBasis: Exact October 2012 Qualla original, named museum relation with four mapped exterior components, and visitor information from the museum.
sectionBasis: Heavy pale concrete Festival Hall wall and recessed street window grid, two lower gallery halls, and the muted, weathered green copper planetarium cap on a low circular drum.
limitations: The October 2012 model includes the museum gallery blocks, main street entrance and round planetarium. The separately mapped Centennial Concert Hall and interiors are outside its scope.
The cleared photo constrains the dome and dark window grid. Current mapping stands in for the 2012 rear footprints. Exact glazing, rear roof structures and facade details are estimates.
Original terrain establishes general downtown grade. Small changes at stairs and plazas are approximate.
